messages:
jamie: Heads-up: rolling deploy tonight 23:00 UTC for model-routing-v2. Feature flag "model-route-v2-enable" will be ramped 0->5->25->100 over 60m windows. planning for a quick rollback if errors spike.

jamie: Deploy window: 23:00-01:00 UTC. Canary cohort = 0.5% traffic for first 5m, then 5% (55m), then 25% (20m), final 100% after checks.

deploy-bot: @jamie queued deploy job #3871. Estimated runtime 18m. If you need to abort: `/deploy cancel 3871`

alex: I can take on-call for the first 90m. I'll watch p95 latency, 5xx rate, and per-route token cost.

rachel: Adding release notes: "Enable model-routing-v2 behind feature flag. Improves rerouting latency for long-context chats." Any customer-facing risks?

tanya: No known breaking changes. We moved KV cache handling but kept backward compat. Metrics to watch: routing-fallback-rate, kvcache-miss-rate, cpu-steal on gpu-hosts.

matt: Set alert thresholds: 5xx > 0.5% for 5m -> auto-rollback, p95 latency +30% vs baseline over 5m -> notify, routing-fallback-rate > 1% -> pause ramp.

jamie: Confirming thresholds. Also we'll pin canary to europe-west only for first 20m. After green, expand to global.

rachel: Who flips the FF? ops/console or automated?

jamie: We'll use ffctl for staged rollout. Command sequence below. Ops will approve after canary checks.

jamie: ```
# canary
ffctl set model-route-v2-enable --cohort europe-west --percent 0.5 --note "canary"
# expand
ffctl set model-route-v2-enable --percent 5 --note "ramp-1"
ffctl set model-route-v2-enable --percent 25 --note "ramp-2"
ffctl set model-route-v2-enable --percent 100 --note "full"
```

ops-bot: Reminder: run `./monitor/checklist.sh deploy 3871` before expanding to >5%. Checklist: smoke tests, datastore-latency, token-cost-sanity, infra-oom-check.

alex: I'll run smoke tests and post results here. If anything looks off I'll trigger `/deploy rollback 3871` and `ffctl set model-route-v2-enable --percent 0`

tanya: Also please watch canary session affinity metrics. If sticky sessions drop, we should throttle back to 0.

matt: Logging note: enable extended tracing for cohort users (tag: mr_v2_canary) for 30m after each ramp step. Add retention 72h for the traces.

rachel: Release notes draft updated and linked: https://confluence/internal/releases/rr-model-route-v2. Add the rollback criteria there.

jamie: Quick decision tree: on minor anomaly (single metric blip) -> hold and investigate. On sustained anomaly per thresholds -> rollback FF to 0% and abort deployment. On infra-only alerts (OOMs) -> pin model-version back to v34 and keep FF at 0 while infra team remediates.

alex: Acknowledged. I'll post a 5m cadence update in this thread during the window.

deploy-bot: Deploy job #3871 started (build 2026.03.21-9f3d). Canary region: europe-west.

jamie: Thanks all. If no objections I'll start at 23:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
